lines.concept: Flora starter: a shy sprout that grows into a rooted forest guardian.

members.name: Fernling
members.design: Small round-bodied sprout on stubby legs, with two curled fern fronds on its head like ears. When nervous the fronds curl tight. Big dark eyes, cream belly.

members.name: Bramblehorn
members.design: Leggy, fawn-like quadruped. The fronds have hardened into a small crown of thorny bramble branches. Cream spots along the flanks, alert stance.

members.name: Briarhart
members.palette: deep green, earth brown, moss, berry red
members.design: Massive stag whose antlers are living briar, trailing roots and red berries. Hooves sink into the ground as roots. Shoulders are mossy, earthen plates. Calm, regal pose.

lines.concept: Flame starter: a playful kit that becomes a lion with a forge-hot mane.

members.name: Emberkit
members.design: Small kitten-like creature with an oversized, smouldering tuft of fur on its head and tail tip. Charcoal paws as if it walked through ash. Playful crouch.

members.name: Blazepaw
members.design: Lean, fast young big cat. Flames lick from its shoulders and tail, and its paws glow at the pads, leaving scorch marks. Mid-stride, eager.

members.name: Forgemane
members.palette: molten orange, iron grey, white-hot yellow
members.design: Powerful lion. Its mane is a ring of molten flame held in place by iron-grey armour plates on the brow, chest and forelegs, like hammered metal. Claws are steel. Proud, upright pose.

lines.concept: Water starter: a bobbing swimmer whose shell grows into a living reef.

members.name: Ripplet
members.design: Round, buoyant creature like a little float, with a small sand-coloured shell on its back and flipper feet. Bobs upright. Wide smile.

members.name: Tidalisk
members.design: Lizard-like swimmer with a long tail fin. Its shell has spread into a back plate patterned with wave ripples, as on wet sand. Low, ready-to-pounce stance.

members.name: Coralith
members.palette: deep blue, coral pink, stone grey
members.design: Heavy, armoured reptilian whose back plate has grown into a craggy living reef of pink and orange coral. Tiny fish shelter in the gaps. Thick stone-grey forearms. Sturdy, grounded pose.

members.name: Pipwing
members.design: Plump, round little songbird, almost a ball with a beak. Oversized orange feet, a short jaunty tail cocked upward, and a cream belly. Its beak is always slightly open mid-whistle, with a tiny musical-note-shaped tuft on its head.

members.name: Gustlark
members.design: Sleeker, longer lark. The head tuft has become a swept-back crest, and the wing tips are long and pointed. Brown back, slate wing bars, cream underside. Shown banking in flight with one wing raised.

members.name: Galecrest
members.design: Large soaring bird with a dramatic double crest that streams back like wind-torn banners. Broad bronze wings spread wide, the tail fanned into points. Sharp, confident eye. It should read as fast and proud, not a bird of prey.

lines.concept: The common early rodent. (Planned evolution for the existing Nibbet.)

members.name: Nibbet
members.design: Small, chubby rodent with huge ivory front teeth, round ears and a stubby tail. Cheeks puffed out with something it's chewing. Sits up on its haunches holding a crumb. Mischievous rather than dirty.

members.name: Chiselfang
members.design: Stocky, beaver-like gnawer standing on its hind legs. Two long chisel-shaped teeth, a broad flat tail with cross-hatched texture, and a gnawed stick held like a club. A cocky, buck-toothed grin.

lines.concept: Silk grub to glowing moth. (Planned evolutions for the existing Grubble.)

members.name: Grubble
members.design: Plump, segmented lime-green grub with five pairs of stubby legs and a yellow stripe down each side. A spinneret mouth with a strand of silk trailing behind it. Big friendly eyes.

members.name: Spindlepod
members.design: Spindle-shaped cocoon tightly wrapped in silk spirals, hanging from one thread at the top. Two eyes peek out through a gap in the silk. Barely moves, so the sprite should feel still and patient.

members.name: Lumimoth
members.palette: moon white, pale teal, soft gold
members.design: Delicate moth with broad, rounded forewings covered in softly glowing teal eyespots. Fluffy white thorax ruff, feathery gold antennae. Tiny sparkles drift down from the wings. Hovering, wings open.

lines.concept: A stinging line: larva to wasp regent.

members.name: Needlit
members.design: Small larva with alternating yellow and black bands and a single purple needle on its tail. A defensive pose, tail curled up over its back like a question mark.

members.name: Hivecase
members.design: A pupa sealed inside a hexagonal wax cell, like one cell of a honeycomb. Its eyes show through the translucent wax lid, and its stinger pokes out of the bottom. Rigid and upright.

members.name: Stingarch
members.design: Regal wasp with a crown-like crest of three spikes, four sharp translucent wings and a long, violet-tipped stinger. Its abdomen has gold and black chevrons like a royal sash. Hovering with the stinger angled forward.

lines.concept: Rolling stone line. (Planned evolutions for the existing Pebbit.)

members.name: Pebbit
members.design: Pebble-shaped creature, mostly body, with stubby rock arms, flat feet and a permanently grumpy face. Dusty from rolling, with a few small pebbles stuck to it. Looks like it just tumbled down a hill and is annoyed about it.

members.name: Bouldrum
members.design: Barrel-shaped boulder on short legs that drums on its own hollow belly with rocky fists. Cracks across its shell show packed earth inside. Its mouth is open mid-drum-roll.

members.name: Cragmount
members.design: A hulking living cliffside on four stumpy pillar legs. Its back is a jagged mountain ridge with patches of moss and a few pebbles tumbling off. A small, stern face under a rocky brow.

lines.concept: Flaky shale line. (Shalehorn already exists; Flintling is its planned pre-evolution.)

members.name: Flintling
members.design: Small quadruped chipped from dark flint, with sharp faceted edges and a single conical horn. White chips mark the fresh breaks. Orange sparks flicker at its hooves and horn tip. Head lowered to charge.

members.name: Shalehorn
members.design: Rhino-like creature whose large horn is made of thin layered shale that flakes off in sheets when it charges. Body has visible strata lines.

members.name: Duskit
members.design: Tiny round bat that is mostly ears: two huge, sensitive pink-lined ears and small wings. Eyes squeezed shut, because it navigates by sound. Hanging upside down, wrapped in its wings.

members.name: Echowing
members.design: Sleeker bat with wide indigo wings and concentric ripple markings on the wing membranes that show its echo calls. Mouth wide mid-shriek, with small fangs. Flying straight at the viewer.

members.name: Umbravane
members.design: Large, elegant bat whose wings look like tattered night sky flecked with silver stars. A long tail ending in an arrow like a weathervane. Graceful glide pose, silhouetted against a moonless sky.

members.name: Coilbit
members.design: Small floating copper coil, a short spring of wire, with a single round eye in the middle and two magnet-pole nubs (red and blue tips) on the ends. Static sparks crackle around it.

members.name: Dynacoil
members.design: Three copper coils fused around a glowing yellow core, arranged like a dynamo. Arcs of electricity jump between the coils, and the core has the eye. It should look like it's spinning.

members.name: Zaptole
members.design: Fat teal tadpole with a lightning-bolt-shaped tail and two rows of glowing yellow spots. Wiggling swim pose with its tail mid-zigzag. Tiny back legs just starting to show.

members.name: Galvanewt
members.design: Slender teal newt with a frilled crest and gills that crackle with electricity. Yellow battery-like stripes run down its back. A low, alert crouch with the tail curled.

lines.concept: A gliding squirrel that rides storm winds.

members.name: Sparrel
members.design: Squirrel with a huge, fluffy golden tail that collects static, so its fur stands on end in spikes. It clutches an acorn that sparks. Sitting up, cheeky expression.

members.name: Stormglider
members.design: Flying squirrel shown spread-eagled, with wide grey gliding membranes edged in crackling lightning. White belly, yellow cheek pouches that store charge. The tail streams behind like a rudder.

members.name: Joltlet
members.design: Round little hedgehog whose quills are short yellow lightning spikes. Brown face, white tummy, tiny feet. It's half-curled into a crackling ball, peeking out.

members.name: Joltquill
members.design: Larger hedgehog standing upright on its hind legs. Its long jagged quills crackle like a storm cloud and are flared outward in threat. Arms in a ready stance.

lines.concept: A firefly that flashes a charged light.

members.name: Flickerfly
members.design: Small black firefly with a big, glowing lime-green abdomen, stubby wings and long antennae. Cheerful hovering pose. The glow should be the brightest part of the sprite.

lines.concept: A small fish that becomes a shark.

members.name: Finnick
members.design: Small silvery fish, very ordinary except for one oversized red dorsal fin that it is very proud of. Shown sideways, flapping out of the water with its mouth agape.

members.name: Riptooth
members.design: Sleek navy shark with a white underbelly, a scarred snout, an enormous toothy grin and a ragged red dorsal fin left over from Finnick. A lunging bite pose, coming at the viewer.

lines.concept: A clam that dreams up pearls of foresight.

members.name: Shellop
members.design: Small lilac scallop shell with frilly edges, two eyes peeking out from between the halves and a tongue poking out. Sits on the sand, slightly open.

members.name: Pearlseer
members.design: An open clam with a large, luminous pearl floating above it like a crystal ball, glowing violet. Wise, half-lidded eyes along the shell rim. Mystical sparkles around the pearl.

members.name: Pinchet
members.design: Small coral-red crab with mismatched claws, one tiny and one comically big. Stalk eyes and a sideways scuttle pose, big claw raised.

members.name: Anvilcrab
members.design: Heavy crab whose big claw has become an anvil-shaped iron hammer. Its shell is coral red with iron-grey plating and rivet-like bumps. Braced on short legs, claw raised to strike.

members.name: Driftjel
members.design: Small translucent pink jellyfish with a dome bell, two curly tentacles and a faint purple inner glow. Drifting gently, tentacles swaying.

members.name: Stingsail
members.design: Man-o'-war-like creature with a tall translucent blue sail crest on top of a pink float and long violet trailing tentacles. A drifting pose leaning with the wind. Should feel large and ominous.

lines.concept: A seal pup that grows into a rune-tusked walrus.

members.name: Selkin
members.design: Fluffy white seal pup with huge dark eyes, frost-tipped whiskers and a pale-blue nose. Lying on its belly, flippers tucked. Almost too cute.

members.name: Walrune
members.design: Massive blue-grey walrus sitting upright, with long ice tusks carved with glowing cyan rune marks. Thick folds of blubber, a bristly moustache and a wise, heavy-lidded gaze.

lines.concept: A playful otter that becomes a river brawler.

members.name: Otterpop
members.design: Small brown otter floating on its back, holding a smooth pebble on its chest. Sleek wet fur, cream face, tiny paws. Content expression.

members.name: Rapidrift
members.design: Muscular otter standing in a boxing stance, with water swirling around its fists like hand wraps. Darker fur, a cream chest and a bandana-like fur pattern. Tail braced for balance.

lines.concept: A spore bud that blooms into a pungent giant flower.

members.name: Sporebud
members.design: Bulb-shaped bud on little root feet. Its closed purple petals leak puffs of yellow spores. Two leaf arms and a drowsy face on the bulb.

members.name: Toxbloom
members.design: Half-open flower with drooping violet petals and dripping nectar. A face in the flower's centre, a green stem body and leaf arms. Swaying unsteadily, as if dizzy from its own scent.

members.name: Rotblossom
members.design: Enormous squat flower like a giant rafflesia, with five thick maroon petals spotted white and a gaping central maw. Small vine arms, visible stink lines. The petals almost fill the frame.

members.name: Petalkin
members.design: Tiny humanoid sprite whose skirt is a pink flower bloom and whose hair is two white petals. Small leaf in hand, half-hiding behind it shyly.

members.name: Blossprite
members.design: Graceful flower fairy with four translucent petal wings and a crown of rose blossoms. A flowing petal dress, mid-twirl, scattering petals.

lines.concept: Seeds that drift on the wind.

members.name: Puffseed
members.design: Small dandelion clock: a round white seed-head body with a face, tiny leaf arms and a short stem leg. Floating, a few seeds drifting off.

members.name: Dandeloft
members.design: Tall, slender dandelion creature holding a huge fluffy seed head above it like a hot-air balloon, its feet dangling below. A yellow flower collar at its neck.

lines.concept: A cactus that learns to box.

members.name: Pricklet
members.design: Small round cactus with a single pink flower on top, stubby arms and lots of tiny spines like a pin cushion. Squinting, sun-loving expression.

members.name: Saguardo
members.design: Tall saguaro cactus with two muscular arm branches raised in a boxer's guard. Spines cluster on its 'knuckles'. A stern face with a pink flower on its head like a headband.

lines.concept: A mushroom haunted by forest spirits.

members.name: Shroomp
members.design: Tiny mushroom with a big red cap with white spots and stubby feet. A worried little face under the cap. Waddling.

members.name: Grimcap
members.design: Tall, ghostly mushroom with a drooping grey-violet cap and a lantern-like glow underneath. Its stem fades into wispy spirit trails instead of feet. Hollow glowing eyes.

lines.concept: A digging mole of the volcano.

members.name: Cindig
members.design: Small mole with glowing ember claws and dark soot rings around its eyes like goggles. Popping out of a hole, with dirt and sparks around it.

members.name: Calderhulk
members.design: Huge burrowing beast with a volcano-crater hump on its back that smokes and glows with lava. Basalt-black hide with orange cracks and massive digging claws. Heavy, low stance.

lines.concept: An incense burner that reads the future in smoke.

members.name: Censerling
members.design: Small round brass incense burner with a face on the lid, swinging from its own chain. Fragrant grey smoke curls from the vents in pretty spirals.

members.name: Pyreoracle
members.design: Floating, ornate brass brazier with violet flames inside that form a third eye. Smoke streams down from it like robes. Two thin chain arms. Mysterious and solemn.

members.name: Brimgecko
members.design: Gecko with big sticky toe pads, sulfur-yellow skin and red warning stripes. Licking its own eyeball. Small puffs of yellow smoke from its nostrils.

members.name: Kilnpup
members.design: Puppy made of fired terracotta clay, with a glowing kiln opening for a mouth. Little cracks glow orange when it's excited. Wagging, playful pose.

members.name: Kilnhound
members.design: Large guard dog of glazed stoneware with a glowing furnace grille in its chest. Thick, statuesque legs. Sitting on guard like a temple statue.

lines.concept: A snow hare that shines with aurora light.

members.name: Snowhop
members.design: Round white hare with long ears tipped with frost and a pale blue nose. Shown mid-hop with all four feet off the ground. Small puff of snow beneath.

members.name: Aurorabbit
members.design: Elegant, long-legged hare with very long flowing ears that shimmer with aurora greens and violets. Ribbons of light trail behind it. Standing tall and alert.

lines.concept: A crystal shard that grows into a glacier crown.

members.name: Rimeshard
members.design: Floating jagged ice-crystal shard with a face reflected in its facets. Cold mist drifts off it. A few small crystals orbit it.

members.name: Hailcrown
members.design: Glacier golem with a crown of ice spikes, a granite body seamed with blue ice and heavy fists. A stomping pose, with frost spreading from its feet.

members.name: Yetling
members.design: Small yeti cub with shaggy white fur, a grey face and huge blue-grey feet. Holding a snowball overhead, about to throw it.

members.name: Avalanchor
members.design: Huge yeti with ice-encased fists like gauntlets and a back shaped like a snowy mountain ridge. Mid-punch, snow flying. Fierce but noble.

members.name: Gruffkid
members.design: Small beige goat kid with tiny nub horns and a little white beard tuft. Head lowered, ready to butt. Stubborn expression.

members.name: Ramstrike
members.design: Muscular brown ram standing on its hind legs in a fighter's stance, with curled horns and wrapped forehooves. White chest fluff.

members.name: Summitram
members.design: Massive ram whose spiral horns are solid grey stone with gold-veined tips. Standing proudly on a rock peak, chest out, beard flowing.

members.name: Calmkoa
members.design: Small grey koala seated cross-legged, eyes closed in meditation, with a eucalyptus leaf balanced on its head. White ear tufts.

members.name: Zenkoa
members.design: Koala martial artist floating cross-legged with a soft violet aura. Prayer beads around its neck, one palm raised. Calm but powerful.

members.name: Mantlet
members.design: Small leaf-green mantis with oversized foreclaws held up like boxing gloves. Big triangle head, pink eyes. Determined little stance.

members.name: Prayblade
members.design: Tall green mantis whose forearms are long blades with gleaming edges. Folded wings drape like a cape. A fencer's stance, one blade forward.

members.name: Slimlet
members.design: Small purple slug with two eye stalks, a glistening green slime trail and a few drips. Sluggish, sleepy expression.

members.name: Slogslug
members.design: Enormous mud-caked purple slug with a shell-like hump of hardened earth on its back. Thick green ooze drips around it. Low and wide.

lines.concept: A fume cloud that becomes a vulture.

members.name: Smogling
members.design: Small round puff of grey-green smog with a face and two wispy arms. Coughing, with little smoke rings.

members.name: Miasmaw
members.design: Vulture made of swirling fumes, with a gas-mask-like beak and yellow eyes. Its wings trail smog. Perched, hunched over.

members.name: Cauldrop
members.design: Tiny black iron cauldron on three stubby legs, bubbling with green brew. Two eyes peek over the rim, and a ladle handle sticks out like an antenna.

members.name: Brewitch
members.design: Witch-like spirit rising out of a cauldron. A pointed hat made of steam, ladle-shaped arms and a trailing violet body. Cackling.

members.name: Burrowl
members.design: Small, long-legged sand-coloured owl standing at the entrance of a burrow. Wide yellow eyes, head tilted sideways.

members.name: Dunestrix
members.design: Larger owl with sand-coloured wings that whip up small dust devils. Golden eyes, talons dug into the sand. Wings half-spread.

lines.concept: A sandworm that becomes a dune wyrm.

members.name: Sandling
members.design: Small segmented sandworm poking out of the sand, with a round mouth ringed with tiny teeth and no visible eyes. Swaying.

members.name: Dunewyrm
members.design: Enormous serpent wyrm with armoured sand-gold segments, a fringe of bone-white spikes and a crown-like head. Bursting out of the dunes. Should fill the frame and be clearly rare and powerful.

members.name: Augerbit
members.design: Small mole-like creature with a drill-bit snout, tiny steel claws and dust goggles. Mid-dig.

members.name: Bormaw
members.design: Large drilling beast with a spiral drill jaw, armoured steel plates rusted at the edges and powerful forelimbs. Tunnelling pose, debris flying.

members.name: Rollodillo
members.design: Tan armadillo with banded armour, half curled into a ball and peeking out with one eye. Small ears, pointed snout.

members.name: Breezlet
members.design: Tiny swirl of pale cyan wind with a face and two leaf-shaped arms. Spinning, with a couple of leaves caught in it.

members.name: Cyclonix
members.design: Towering cyclone creature with a funnel-shaped body, swirling debris and two glowing eyes inside the vortex. Arms made of whipping wind.

members.name: Kestrike
members.design: Rust-and-white falcon with strong taloned legs raised in a high kick. Wing feathers flare like a martial-arts sash, and it has fierce black eye stripes.

members.name: Dozelet
members.design: Small sleepy lamb with a cloud-like lavender wool coat and closed eyes. A dream bubble with a little star floats above its head.

members.name: Reverell
members.design: Sheep whose lavender wool forms swirling dream clouds dotted with tiny stars. It walks in its sleep, eyes closed and serene.

members.name: Somnarch
members.design: Majestic ram of dreams with a starry midnight-blue wool cloak and crescent-moon horns. Floating, with dream wisps drifting around it.

members.name: Tickowl
members.design: Small brass owl with clock-face eyes and gear-shaped wings. Its head is tilted, and a ticking motion is implied.

members.name: Chronowl
members.design: Larger owl with a pendulum tail, a clock dial on its chest and wing feathers like clock hands. Its eyes are glowing teal dials.

members.name: Omencat
members.design: Sleek black cat with glowing violet eyes, a third eye on its forehead and a forked tail. Sitting elegantly, staring.

members.name: Riddlecub
members.design: Lion cub with a pharaoh-like striped headdress pattern in its fur and blue eye markings. Head tilted curiously.

members.name: Sphyrion
members.design: Sphinx with golden wings and a lapis-and-sandstone headdress. Lounging regally on a stone plinth, with eyes that see everything.

members.name: Wisplet
members.design: Small floating wisp of pale blue light with a sad face and a trailing tail. Faintly translucent.

members.name: Mournlight
members.design: Lantern-shaped spirit whose body is a glowing lamp of mournful blue light. A cracked glass face and drifting chain arms.

members.name: Veilwraith
members.design: Tall wraith in a flowing black veil with a pale, mask-like face and long clawed hands reaching forward. Violet eyes.

members.name: Parasoul
members.design: Old paper umbrella with faded red paper, one large eye and a long tongue, hopping on its wooden handle. Torn edges.

members.name: Cairnling
members.design: Small stack of grey stones with ghostly blue eyes glowing in the gaps. Moss on the top stone.

members.name: Cairnwight
members.design: Tall cairn of stacked dark stones forming a hulking figure with long arms and a glowing blue core in its chest.

members.name: Pilfurr
members.design: Raccoon kit with a black bandit mask and a ringed tail. Holding a stolen shiny coin and looking over its shoulder.

members.name: Banditail
members.design: Raccoon on two legs in a black mask, with a bushy ringed tail stuffed with stolen gold trinkets. Sly grin.

members.name: Snickerpup
members.design: Hyena pup with dusty tan spotted fur, big round ears and an oversized giggling grin.

members.name: Cacklehyde
members.design: Muscular hyena brute with a bristling red-tipped mane and scarred knuckles. Standing upright, laughing.

members.name: Grimpkin
members.design: Small imp wearing a carved pumpkin as a helmet, with a forked tail and purple sparkly mischief magic in one hand.

members.name: Rivetbug
members.design: Small pill bug made of overlapping steel plates fastened with rivets. Half-curled, peeking out.

members.name: Ironshell
members.design: Large armoured beetle with plate armour like a knight's and a long horn like a lance. Bronze trim. A charging stance.

members.name: Chimelet
members.design: Small wind chime with hanging metal tubes for legs and a cheerful face on the top bar. A pastel ribbon.

members.name: Carillon
members.design: Bell-tower creature with a large silver bell body, small arms and chimes that ring a melody. Visible musical notes.

members.name: Gearpup
members.design: Small robot puppy with gear-shaped ears, a wind-up key in its back and a wagging spring tail.

members.name: Clankhound
members.design: Large mechanical hound with piston legs, a steam vent on its back and a glowing red eye. A guard-dog stance.

members.name: Dewlette
members.design: Tiny fairy whose body is a clear blue dewdrop with a face and a leaf hat. Sitting on a leaf.

members.name: Dewdancer
members.design: Graceful fairy dancer whose dress is made of water droplets catching the light. Mid-pirouette.

members.name: Fluffawn
members.design: Cream fawn with cloud-like fluff on its chest and tiny flower antlers. Big, gentle eyes.

members.name: Starlette
members.design: Small five-pointed golden star creature with a twinkling face and a trailing sparkle tail.

members.name: Scalelet
members.design: Small jade serpentine dragon with stubby legs, a big head and oversized cream belly scales. Baby-like.

members.name: Ridgedrake
members.design: Lithe jade drake with grey stone ridges along its spine, small wings and a long tail. Alert, about to take off.

members.name: Peakwyrm
members.design: Massive dragon whose spine forms a mountain range of slate peaks, with gold-tipped stone horns and great wings. Rearing. Fills the frame.

lines.concept: A whirlpool sea drake. (Moved here from the Water starter line: too strong for a starter.)

members.name: Coilfin
members.design: Small, deep-blue eel-like fish with a frilly white fin crest, coiled around itself like a spring.

members.name: Maelstrake
members.design: Huge sea drake coiled in a spiral like a whirlpool, with a frill of white foam and a long, sinuous body. Fills the frame.

members.name: Verdrake
members.design: Dragon covered in moss and blossoms, with branch-like horns and leafy wings. Peaceful but ancient.

members.name: Lumbear
members.design: Huge sleepy brown bear lying across a path, snoring, with a cream belly. Fills the frame.

members.name: Snoutle
members.design: Small pink piglet with an oversized snout always sniffing the ground. Curly tail.

members.name: Truffhog
members.design: Brown boar with a powerful digging snout, small tusks and truffles growing on its bristly back.

members.name: Hummling
members.design: Tiny iridescent green hummingbird with blurred wings, a long beak and a pink throat.

members.name: Mimicat
members.design: Cream cat with patchwork fur patches that copy the patterns of other creatures. Sly smile.

members.name: Woolump
members.design: Small, round white sheep that is mostly wool, with a grey face and tiny legs.

members.name: Woolossus
members.design: Gigantic sheep whose white wool is a mountain of fluff, with a small grey face peeking out. Fills the frame.

members.name: Ashcrow
members.design: Crow whose feathers smoulder at the tips with ember orange, trailing ash. Perched, cawing.

members.name: Rimewisp
members.design: Floating frozen lantern spirit with a cold blue flame inside a frosted glass body.

members.name: Bellbuoy
members.design: Old harbour buoy, rusty red with a sea-green base, whose bell tolls by itself. Barnacles and a ghostly face.

members.name: Platefin
members.design: Small armoured fish with a bony plate head and a tan body. Ancient look.

members.name: Dunkleon
members.design: Massive armoured fish with a huge bony jaw plate that slices like shears. Slate and bone colours. Fills the frame.

members.name: Scuttlite
members.design: Small, trilobite-like amber-coloured creature with segmented armour and many tiny legs.

members.name: Scorptera
members.design: Huge sea scorpion with paddle legs, armoured amber plates and a spiked tail. A menacing raised-claws pose.

lines.concept: The three Peak Wardens, each guarding a mountain.

members.name: Halvorn
members.design: Great owl-stag of the glacier: an owl's head and wings on a stag's body, with ice-crystal antlers and a frost cape. Should read as ancient and serene. Fills the frame.

members.name: Thundrel
members.design: Storm titan: a bear-like humanoid wrapped in storm clouds, with lightning-bolt horns and fists crackling with thunder. Should look fierce and electric. Fills the frame.

members.name: Solaric
members.design: Sun spirit lion with a radiant golden mane like a solar corona, a third eye of crimson fire and floating rings. Should look serene and powerful. Fills the frame.

members.name: Vaelith
members.design: Ancient spirit dragon of silver and pale violet, with long translucent wings like veils, a skeletal crown and trailing spectral mist. The region's great legend. Fills the frame.

members.name: Primmi
members.design: Tiny primordial creature, soft pink and white, with big curious eyes, a long tail and small wing-like ears. Floating playfully. Simple shapes that hint at every other monster.
